newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends firmer in dull market.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends firmer in dull market.

text.p: Scant buying of the U.S. currency helped the Bangladesh taka to end firmer on Sunday at 42.5300/5360 to the dollar in interbank trading against a previous close of 42.5300/5400, dealers said.

Taka was quoted weaker at 42.5300/42.5450 per dollar in early trade but recovered later amid a lack of transactions. Dealers said trade was thin due largely to the weekend closure of international markets, straining the dollar.
"Major banks were absent. There were very few deals with only some local private banks buying small amounts (of dollars)," said one dealer.
Call money was traded at 4.75 to 5.25 percent, down from Saturday's 5.25 to 5.50 percent, dealers said.
